product_overview: SoloDeskOS is an AI solo-business operating system that helps independent operators manage leads, enrich prospects, generate proposals and invoices, and onboard new clients in one connected workflow. It centralizes search, lead research, document creation, and CSV import into a streamlined 5-gate process.
core_goals: Find leads, clients, proposals, and invoices quickly from a single search experience
Research and progress leads through qualification stages
Create client proposals and invoices from a workspace tied to the client record
Export branded proposal and invoice documents
Import leads from CSV files into the lead engine
Complete client onboarding after payment is confirmed

features.name: Global Quick Search
features.description: Provides a universal search experience across leads, clients, proposals, and invoices so users can quickly jump to the right record.
user_flows: Navigate to /dashboard -> Open global search -> Type a client name, proposal identifier, proposal title, or invoice number -> View categorized results -> Open a matching record
Navigate to /dashboard -> Open global search -> Type a query -> Navigate using the keyboard -> See the matching lead, client, proposal, or invoice page

features.name: Lead Management and Deep Research
features.description: Lets users review leads, run deep research on a lead, and advance the lead through its lifecycle stages.
user_flows: Navigate to /leads -> Open a lead record -> Review lead details and qualification tier -> Run deep research -> See site health and competitor pricing findings -> Advance the lead stage
Navigate to /leads -> Open a lead record -> Run deep research -> See a pre-built research profile when quota-limited -> Continue working with the lead record
Navigate to /leads -> Open a lead record -> Review the lead information -> Move the lead forward through approval gates -> See the updated lead stage

features.name: Client Workspace and Document Flow
features.description: Gives users a client workspace where they can create proposals, create invoices, and move clients toward onboarding.
user_flows: Navigate to /clients -> Open a client record -> Create a proposal -> Continue into the proposal builder for that client
Navigate to /clients -> Open a client record -> Create an invoice -> Continue into the invoice builder for that client
Navigate to /clients -> Open a client record -> Confirm the client is ready for billing -> Create an invoice from the workspace
Navigate to /clients -> Open a client record -> Confirm payment has been received -> Open onboarding for that client

features.name: Proposal Builder
features.description: Allows users to edit proposal scope, approve the proposal, and export a branded PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /proposals/builder -> Edit the proposal scope and details -> Review the proposal content -> Export the proposal as a PDF
Navigate to /proposals/builder -> Edit the proposal scope and details -> Approve the proposal through the approval gate -> See the proposal status update -> Export the proposal as a PDF

features.name: Invoice Builder
features.description: Allows users to create and customize invoices, mark them as sent, confirm payment, and export a PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Customize line items, payment methods, and notes -> Export the invoice as a PDF
Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Customize invoice details -> Mark the invoice as sent -> See the invoice status change to Sent
Navigate to /invoices/builder -> Review the invoice details -> Confirm payment received -> See the invoice status change to Paid -> Open the newly created onboarding record

features.name: CSV Lead Import
features.description: Lets users upload a CSV file or load a sample CSV, map columns automatically, and import leads into the lead engine.
user_flows: Navigate to /import -> Choose a CSV file or load the sample leads CSV -> Verify the detected column mappings -> Confirm the import -> See leads added to the lead engine
Navigate to /import -> Load the sample leads CSV -> Review the mapped fields -> Confirm the import -> See imported leads ready for follow-up
